compute.note: Parameters evaluated: NetKet 3.13.0 Jastrow stores the strictly lower triangle of W, N(N-1)/2 = 144*143/2 = 10296 real (float32) weights, which is also what vmc.py prints as n_params (tree_size_real_nonzero). Samples: 1024 per SR step, 1024 chains of length 1, each sample one sweep of 144 single-spin proposals, no discard. Iterations: 10^4 steps (--max_step default). Driver: nkx.driver.VMC_SRt (n_parameters >= n_samples = 1024). After training the energy is estimated from 2^20 samples. stored sigma 0.00073 vs sqrt(stored variance 0.54852065 / 2^20) = 0.00072: consistent with the script's 2^20-sample final estimate (--estim_size default). Provenance: the value entered VarBench in af1d48f (2022-09-01, Dian Wu); the linked script was added to varbench/methods in c686621 (2024-07-30) without the value changing, so the script is the authors' later reconstruction of the baseline, not a log of the run (the same holds for the TFIsing RBM rows, scripts/defects.mjs). The 2^20-sample final estimate is corroborated by the stored sigma; batch size and step count are not independently corroborated. No device or time is recorded (the conda env includes CUDA; the README says a GPU is "usually needed for VMC on larger lattices", which is not a statement about these runs).
